_comment: Clarity in the Quran (@ClarityInTheQuran, UC0eBu0ZXcF20pTAG3lUnPXA) localized metadata. Tranche 1 (ar, ur on 6 videos) applied 2026-08-22. Tranche 2 — Bengali added, and all 18 uploads covered — applied 2026-08-22 at the owner's explicit direction after the Bengali quality caveat was raised and overruled.
_why_this_exists: vidIQ keyword research, 2026-08-22. 'quran explained in english' = 5,268 searches/month. Bare 'quran' = 1,398,036/month, of which the US is 6.5%. 'surah' = 283,511/month, of which Bangladesh alone is 47.7% and Pakistan 28.4%. 'islamic video' = 662,172/month, 90% Bangladesh + Pakistan. The reference channel, @deepmadesimple, is US-English Bible study — its audience and its language are the same thing. Clarity copied the format into a niche where they are not. English is not the language of this channel's market; it is the language of its template.
_default_language: YouTube ignores localizations unless the video's snippet.defaultLanguage is set. Unset on every upload here, so the script sets it to 'en' in the SAME write. Miss this and the write succeeds and does nothing — the worst kind of failure.
_CITATION_RULE: READ THIS BEFORE ADDING A VIDEO. A verse citation appears in a localized description ONLY when the video's own transcript has been read and the citation confirmed. In tranche 1 the anxiety video (StCW3ERkWwc) was given 'Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:28' from inference — its English title says only 'the verse that stops anxiety' — and that was WRONG. The transcript builds on Al-Imran 3:173 (hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel, at Uhud) and Al-Baqarah 2:38; 13:28 belongs to a different upload, 5Fb1iERyIhs. It was live in Arabic and Urdu for roughly twenty minutes before a transcript check caught it. On a channel whose entire proposition is explaining the Quran honestly — and which already carries a public 'AI BE AWARE' comment — a fabricated citation in a language the owner cannot read is the worst failure available. Videos whose transcripts have NOT been read carry a faithful description with NO verse number.
_verified: Transcript-confirmed citations: StCW3ERkWwc (Al-Imran 3:173, Al-Baqarah 2:38), PUPdFpvEA04 (Al-Isra 17:23, the verb qada), 4N-MXuYjDUA (Ash-Sharh 94:5-6, ma'a), 5Fb1iERyIhs (Ar-Ra'd 13:28), cjtKWsFZbcg (Al-Imran 3:134, kazimin al-ghayz). Every other entry is deliberately citation-free.
_bengali: Added at the owner's explicit instruction. The caveat stands and is recorded rather than silently dropped: Bengali is the language least checkable from here, and it is also the single largest opportunity in the data at 47.7% of all 'surah' searches. Register follows Bengali Islamic usage — Arabic loanwords in their established Bengali forms (কুরআন, সূরা, আয়াত, আল্লাহ, ঈমান) rather than Sanskritised equivalents. Have a native reader check these before the next tranche of languages.
